metaDescription: Order custom 100 149 page pencils for bulk events. Reliable writing with ample space for your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For events where a standard pencil runs out too soon, custom 100 149 page pencils offer the extra writing length your recipients need. Whether you're equipping students with study tools or providing note-taking supplies at a conference, these pencils hold up through extended use. Add your logo with foil stamping or full-color imprinting on designs like the Continental Collection or Scholar Kit for a polished look that lasts.
